rm_mark_checkpoint.title: Race Manager: mark checkpoint
rm_mark_checkpoint.desc: Drop a checkpoint where the car is standing, facing the way it points

rm_undo_checkpoint.title: Race Manager: undo last checkpoint
rm_undo_checkpoint.desc: Remove the checkpoint that was placed most recently

rm_set_start.title: Race Manager: set start line
rm_set_start.desc: Put the grid where the car is standing

rm_toggle_players.title: Race Manager: player list
rm_toggle_players.desc: Show or hide the player list

rm_end_race.title: Race Manager: end race
rm_end_race.desc: Stop the run and take the result as it stands. Does nothing when you are not racing

rm_reposition.title: Race Manager: reposition
rm_reposition.desc: Flip the car upright in place. Car must be stopped. Logs a 1 minute recovery penalty during a race

rm_spare_tire.title: Race Manager: spare tire
rm_spare_tire.desc: Change one flat tire. Car must be stopped. 30 second hold (no time penalty)

rm_repair.title: Race Manager: repair
rm_repair.desc: Repair the car. Car must be stopped. 1 minute hold (no time penalty)

rm_fuel.title: Race Manager: fuel +25%
rm_fuel.desc: Add fuel. Only works inside a pit box during a race. 20 second hold

rm_lights.title: Race Manager: lights menu
rm_lights.desc: Open the lights submenu: headlights, lightbar, fog, siren, hazards, horn and flash

rm_stella_toggle.title: Race Manager: Stella power on/off
rm_stella_toggle.desc: Toggle the Stella unit power (screen on or off)

rm_stella_pass.title: Race Manager: Stella push to pass
rm_stella_pass.desc: Ask the car ahead to let you by. With a car asking you, it lets them by

rm_stella_ok.title: Race Manager: Stella OK
rm_stella_ok.desc: Let the car asking to pass by

rm_stella_sos.title: Race Manager: Stella red button
rm_stella_sos.desc: Tell the cars around you that you are stopped. Press again when you are moving
